waves.name: Nightly sequence job
waves.rationale: One job runs three programs in order and touches no shared data, so one sentence describes the wave and it needs no cut. Its boundary is the job's step order and return codes, since no dataset exists to compare. The duplicate STEP2 on line 5 must be settled before the boundary is defined.
waves.unblocks: Nothing in the tree. No other unit depends on it. It proves the toolchain and the step-order harness, and that is all.
